selection: First 20 seed records in stable ID order; convenience pilot, not a random or database-derived sample.
reviewer: Codex AI-assisted preliminary triage; independent human adjudication pending for every record.
decision_rule: Advance conservatively when an explicit scope signal is present. Unclear is not exclusion. Abstracts do not establish final eligibility, quality, calibration or novelty.

records.basis: Title and official author repository; abstract not retrieved
records.evidence: The title explicitly concerns kernel/model uncertainty. The author repository identifies Nan and Ji, CVPR 2020, and provides synthetic kernel-error and real-image experiments.
records.full_text_question: Verify the abstract, correction mechanism and kernel-error distribution; distinguish parameter uncertainty from wrong-family mismatch.

records.evidence: NETT combines a learned regularizer with data consistency and convergence analysis. Its abstract reports reconstruction of unknowns that differ from the training-image type.
records.full_text_question: Does the full evaluation operationalize distribution shift relevant to this review, or is this a background regularization method only? The 2018 preprint and 2020 journal report are one lineage.

records.evidence: The abstract studies sensitivity to small image or sampling perturbations, loss of small structural changes, and cases where additional samples reduce reconstruction quality.
records.full_text_question: Separate adversarial perturbation, acquisition mismatch and missing-structure tests; record perturbation scales and comparator access. Link the 2019 preprint to the 2020 journal report.

records.criterion_3: Real blur and synthetic-to-real degradation gap
records.evidence: RealBlur introduces paired real sharp/blurred images using a capture and postprocessing pipeline, motivated by the gap between synthetic blur benchmarks and real acquisition.
records.full_text_question: Inspect alignment, exposure and pairing limitations; assess whether it supports controlled mismatch tests. RealBlur is not a CCTV-specific benchmark.

metadata.Authors: Rim, Jaesung; Lee, Haeyun; Won, Jucheol; Cho, Sunghyun

records.basis: Author-hosted published PDF abstract and opening page
records.evidence: The model-mismatch compensation network combines an unrolled model-based branch with a learned correction branch and evaluates lensless reconstruction under an imperfect forward model.
records.full_text_question: Extract exactly what is corrected and what mismatch is held out; test whether uncertainty, measurement support or abstention are actually evaluated. Only the opening material was inspected here.

records.evidence: The abstract motivates deep-equilibrium inverse solvers through fixed-point reconstruction, accuracy and computational properties. An explicit mismatch or reliability evaluation is not established by this abstract.
records.full_text_question: Locate a criterion-3 experiment or claim. If none exists, retain as architectural background rather than an included primary study. Do not exclude on this pilot alone.

records.criterion_3: Image posterior uncertainty and multimodal solutions
records.evidence: Deep Probabilistic Imaging uses a generative variational approach to characterize posterior uncertainty and multimodal reconstructions in computational imaging, including interferometry and MRI.
records.full_text_question: Distinguish approximate posterior diversity from empirical calibration; determine whether the operator is fixed or uncertain.

metadata.Title: Deep Probabilistic Imaging: Uncertainty Quantification and Multi-modal Solution Characterization for Computational Imaging

records.evidence: The paper introduces a framework and hallucination maps for tomographic reconstruction, relating learned-prior failures to measurement and null-space components, with numerical demonstrations.
records.full_text_question: Which maps require the unknown ground truth? Separate retrospective assessment from a deployable hallucination detector and inspect sensitivity to an incorrect operator.

records.evidence: BSRGAN uses a practical randomized degradation design spanning blur, downsampling, noise and compression, including shuffled processing order and camera-processing effects.
records.full_text_question: Extract training/test degradation overlap and real-image evaluation; do not treat visual realism as measurement faithfulness or calibrated uncertainty.

records.evidence: Real-ESRGAN trains from synthetic pairs using a high-order degradation process and models ringing and overshoot artifacts to address practical blind super-resolution.
records.full_text_question: Identify which degradation combinations are evaluated rather than simulated only; separate perceptual restoration from identity/detail recovery.

records.evidence: The paper constructs image-valued prediction intervals with statistical guarantees and demonstrates the approach on imaging applications including MRI, phase imaging and electron microscopy.
records.full_text_question: Record the coverage unit, calibration split and exchangeability assumptions; determine which claims survive operator or device shift. Distribution-free does not mean valid under arbitrary shift.

records.criterion_3: Posterior reconstruction and transfer across image distributions
records.evidence: DDRM uses a pretrained diffusion model for linear inverse problems and describes posterior-based restoration and transfer beyond the training-image distribution.
records.full_text_question: Determine known-operator and noise assumptions, posterior approximation error and whether calibration is tested; sample diversity alone is not calibration.

records.basis: Title and official author repository; abstract not retrieved
records.evidence: The AirNet title explicitly targets unknown corruption. Its official repository documents all-in-one and individual denoising, deraining and dehazing training/evaluation modes.
records.full_text_question: Retrieve the abstract and paper. Does one model handle separate task families, simultaneous compound corruption, unseen severity, or all of these? Do not equate all-in-one with compound-chain evaluation.

records.basis: Preprint abstract; peer review not established
records.evidence: Conffusion adapts pretrained diffusion models to predict confidence intervals for image reconstruction, including super-resolution and inpainting.
records.full_text_question: Extract interval construction, calibration assumptions and OOD evaluation. Keep preprint status unless a corresponding peer-reviewed version is verified.

records.evidence: DPS approximates posterior sampling for noisy linear and nonlinear inverse problems, including settings with Gaussian or Poisson noise.
records.full_text_question: Separate known functional form from genuinely unknown operators; record any empirical uncertainty calibration rather than assuming it follows from posterior terminology.

records.basis: Official search snippet only; full abstract not retrieved
records.evidence: The retrieved record identifies Pseudoinverse-Guided Diffusion Models for Inverse Problems, but page challenges and failed author-PDF retrieval prevented inspection of the complete abstract.
records.full_text_question: Obtain the abstract/full text and test criterion 3. Access failure is not an exclusion reason at this stage; no substantive method coding was verified in this pilot.

records.evidence: DDNM describes zero-shot restoration by refining the null-space component with a pretrained diffusion model while maintaining a data-consistency construction, with an extension for noisy observations.
records.full_text_question: Check when the consistency claim holds and whether null-space detail is supported by evidence. Data consistency alone does not identify the true image or prevent plausible hallucination.

metadata.Title: Zero-Shot Image Restoration Using Denoising Diffusion Null-Space Model

records.criterion_3: Joint image/operator inference in blind reconstruction
records.evidence: BlindDPS uses parallel diffusion models for the image and forward operator, with demonstrations in blind deblurring and turbulence reconstruction.
records.full_text_question: Extract which operator functional forms remain assumed, training requirements for operator priors, identifiability limits and calibration evidence.

records.criterion_3: Joint posterior inference for blind inverse problems
records.evidence: GibbsDDRM proposes a partially collapsed Gibbs sampler for joint signal/operator inference using a diffusion restoration prior; blind image deblurring is among its applications.
records.full_text_question: Extract operator prior/family, sampler approximation and posterior calibration tests. Its additional audio experiments do not negate the central imaging application.

metadata.Title: GibbsDDRM: A Partially Collapsed Gibbs Sampler for Solving Blind Inverse Problems with Denoising Diffusion Restoration

records.evidence: PromptIR uses prompts to condition restoration on degradation information and evaluates denoising, deraining and dehazing under an all-in-one restoration design.
records.full_text_question: Distinguish multiple separate tasks from simultaneous compound chains and unseen operators. The proceedings title omits 'Blind', which appears in the preprint title; this is not a separate study.

metadata.Title: PromptIR: Prompting for All-in-One Image Restoration
